title: Additive negative-total assertion synchronized with Method Flow
failure_signature: A focused x2 test expected the pre-recovery total after two later operational negatives had been retained.
trigger_preconditions: A phase test asserts the effective retained-negative total.
New Method Flow failures were added after the first evidence build.
candidate_workaround: Recompute the total from inherited, x1, synthetic, and x2 categories; update the builder and assertion together; rerun only the focused preflight.
recurrence_guard: Before each focused test run, regenerate the retained-negative register after all newly recorded Method Flow failures and assert the category sum as well as the total.
rollback: Retain the failed focused run with zero canonical credit, restore category-consistent accounting, and rerun the bounded preflight only.
scope_boundary: Focused owner-local test recovery only; no canonical suite, replay, independent-reproduction, or assurance credit.
